_comment: Energy-of-operation parameters in picojoules. Anchored on Horowitz, ISSCC 2014 (int add 0.1 pJ, fp32 mul 3.7 pJ, DRAM ~640 pJ / 32 bits @45nm) and scaled to a modern node; SRAM/HBM values per published on-chip/off-chip figures. mac_pj: one BF16 multiply + f32 accumulate in the ME array (Horowitz 45nm FP16 mul 1.1 + add 0.4 ~ 1.5 pJ, scaled ~1/3; +/-70% PPA band, see sim/me_model.py). EVERY VALUE IS AN ESTIMATE until hardware correlation (validation ladder: docs/architecture/power-thermal.md).
